summary: Jack in the Box Inc. disclosed in an 8-K the entry into a Purchase Agreement for a private securitization issuance. The registrant's special-purpose subsidiary, Jack in the Box Funding, LLC, agreed to sell $500 million of Series 2026-1 7.624% Fixed Rate Senior Secured Notes, Class A-2, under a supplement to a base indenture dated 2019. Interest is quarterly; anticipated repayment is May 2031. The agreement includes standard reps, warranties, covenants, and indemnification. Closing is expected in June 2026. This is a routine debt financing, not a special-situation event. There are no terms for an acquisition, divestiture, or other corporate change.
